Resolves #20530

`learn/benefits/EnterpriseEvaluation.md` is the page for the reader who has to answer for adopting the engine. It takes the questions an architecture review asks (what is adopted, the licence, the supply chain, who maintains it, upgrades, browsers, security, accessibility, testing, migration), answers each with a command or a public record, gives a one-week evaluation plan, and lists what is not there yet. It is registered in `learn/tree.json` and the `PRIORITIES` map and linked from both reader-path files.

Evidence: L3 (the portal on a dev server; every figure read by a command on `dev` at `6431e88cf2`) → L1 required (AC-1 to AC-3: a document, its registration and two checks). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 the page at the guide bar, registered beside `Introduction` and `ArchitectureOverview` | outside-CI: the portal on the dev server at a 1440 px viewport, route `#/learn/benefits/EnterpriseEvaluation`. The navigation tree shows "Enterprise Evaluation" under Benefits. Sixteen headings in "On this page". Two diagrams, both `flowchart TD`, drawn unscaled (297 px and 168 px wide in a 737 px column, each at its own `max-width`), 4 and 6 nodes. Two tables, 10 rows of 3 cells and 17 rows of 2 cells, no split cell. The nine searches render as one list. Every figure has its command in the page's last section and was run on 2026-11-15. |
| AC-2 both reader-path files link the page | `learn/README.md`: the first item of path 2. `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`: the opening of the evaluator bullet. |
| AC-3 link and whitespace checks, no generated file | outside-CI: `node buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` → OK, 395 links. `node buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` → exit 0. `apps/portal/sitemap.xml`, `llms.txt` and `seo.json` are not in the diff. A generator run into a temporary file (`generate.mjs -f seo-json`) yields 174 routes with this page's title (60 characters) and description (149, untruncated) from its frontmatter. |

## Deltas from ticket

1. The seven sharpenings of the intake are applied: [comment 6889057708](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20530#issuecomment-6889057708). The two that change what the ticket asked for: the page does not say "zero runtime `eval`" (two opt-in modules call `new Function`, and it names them), and it carries no commercial offer (the boundary the ticket names allows none before Dec 1).
2. Three sections the ticket does not list: who maintains the engine and what happens if they stop, accessibility, and "What Is Not Here Yet".
3. The page ranks 0.9 in `PRIORITIES`, with the Body pages, and stands first in the evaluator path.
4. The receipts are a table plus a list of searches. A pipe in a code span splits a table cell, and the portal's "On this page" lists a `#` comment line of a fenced block as a heading (defect note sent).
5. Two first-hand passages, which the guide bar's grounding rule asks for: a review of my own two pages, and a Neural Link call on a running Gantt chart.
6. No in-page anchor links: the portal routes by hash.

Identity surface, framing only: the opening is a projection of the apex in `neomjs/neo#adr:neo-identity-source-of-truth-model`, in the pattern of the comparison pages. A cross-family review is required for this class. Review focus: each security sentence against the source, the licence and help sentences against the boundary (no offer, no paid tier named), and the maintainer section's figures against their commands.

One dated dependency: the page names the scheduler and the Gantt chart as on `dev` and planned as version 14.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the pre-commit hook ran the secrets, whitespace and relative-link checks.

## Test Evidence

- Portal render: the route in the AC-1 row, read in the dark theme. First render showed both diagrams as columns of nodes wrapped to 152 px; the labels were shortened and the route read again.
- Source reads behind the security section: `src/DefaultConfig.mjs` (`useAiClient: false`, `useDomApiRenderer: true`, `useSharedWorkers: false`, `mainThreadAddons`), `src/worker/Manager.mjs` (`type: 'module'`, the `window.SharedWorker` check), `src/vdom/VNode.mjs` and `src/main/render/DomApiRenderer.mjs` (`textContent` and `innerHTML`), `src/worker/App.mjs` (`resolveAiClientBoot`, never on GitHub Pages).
- Live reads: `https://neomjs.com/examples/grid/bigData/` answers `200` to a browser user agent; `npm view neo.mjs version license dependencies`; the repository's private vulnerability reporting is enabled (`gh api repos/neomjs/neo/private-vulnerability-reporting`).
- Browser versions come from MDN's compatibility data and the web-features explorer, read on 2026-11-15; the page links MDN.
- Not checked: the light theme, a phone-width viewport, and the page under a content security policy (the page says the engine has not been certified against one).

### `@neo-fable-mnemosyne` commented on 2026-11-15T05:40:38Z

**Author note on the review's two challenge items. The first one found an error on the page, fixed at `b0440554c7`.**

1. **Receipt 6.** Scoping the command to version tags did not print the same number: `'refs/tags/[0-9]*'` gives 17, the unscoped form gave 18. The repository carries two tags for one release, `v11.19.1` and `11.19.1`, both from 2026-01-09. So the tag count was one too high, and the page said "18 releases in 2026" in three places. Two independent reads agree on 17: `gh api repos/neomjs/neo/releases --paginate` holds 17 releases published in 2026, and `npm view neo.mjs time --json` holds 17 versions published in 2026. The commit changes the three figures and receipt 6, nothing else (4 lines in `learn/benefits/EnterpriseEvaluation.md`). `check-whitespace` and `check-relative-links` pass.
2. **`OffscreenCanvas`.** Agreed as you read it: the page lists what every app needs from a browser, and a canvas worker is opt-in.

Your approval is on `1e9235f228`. The head is now `b0440554c7`, so I re-request you once its checks are green; the delta is those four lines.
